verdict.rationale: Mastra's own pricing page claims self-hosting is free and 'Apache 2.0 licensed' (mastra-docs-11, mastra-docs-51), and deployment docs confirm it can run in any Node-compatible environment (mastra-docs-18, mastra-docs-25). However, community evidence directly disputes the license claim, noting Mastra actually ships under the Elastic License v2, which restricts providing the software as a hosted/managed service to third parties and disputes the 'open-source' framing (mastra-comm-2) — a concrete contradiction of the vendor's stated licensing/openness terms. missing for 10: independent confirmation of the actual current license text, clarity on whether self-hosting for internal use (vs. reselling as a service) is unaffected.
